root_cause.text: The vt subsystem fails to update the saved unicode buffer after a console resize while in the alternate screen, because enter_alt_screen() sets vc_uni_lines to NULL, causing vc_do_resize() to skip reallocation, while leave_alt_screen() later restores the stale buffer without checking if the dimensions match, leading to out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "enter_alt_screen() saves vc_uni_lines into vc_saved_uni_lines and sets vc_uni_lines to NULL, a subsequent console resize via vc_do_resize() skips reallocating the unicode buffer because vc_uni_lines is NULL. However, vc_saved_uni_lines still points to the old buffer allocated for the original dimensions. When leave_alt_screen() later restores vc_saved_uni_lines, the buffer dimensions no longer match vc_rows/vc_cols. Any operation that iterates over the unicode buffer using the current dimensions (e.g. csi_J clearing the screen) will access memory out of bounds." The patch adds a check for stale dimensions and frees the saved buffer instead of restoring it.

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce a stale flag for uni_lines in leave_alt_screen to prepare for optimizing or fixing screen restore logic.
intent_record.what: Added a declaration for a local boolean variable 'uni_lines_stale' at the start of the leave_alt_screen function, before the existing conditional check.
intent_record.how: The variable is declared but not yet used in the visible diff; it will be used in subsequent code to track whether the uni_lines (unicode lines) are stale, potentially to avoid unnecessary updates during alt-screen restoration.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential out-of-bounds access when leaving alternate screen after console resize by discarding saved unicode lines if dimensions changed.
intent_record.what: Replaced unconditional restoration of saved unicode lines with a check for dimension changes: if saved rows/cols differ from current, free saved lines instead of restoring; otherwise restore as before.
intent_record.how: Prevents out-of-bounds memory access when leaving alternate screen after a console resize by ensuring the saved unicode lines are only restored when dimensions match; otherwise they are freed and the unicode screen is lazily rebuilt.

candidates.rationale: This statement restores the saved unicode buffer without verifying whether the console dimensions have changed during the alternate screen. If a resize occurred, the stale buffer may have incorrect dimensions, leading to out-of-bounds memory access.

commit 5eb608319bb56464674a71b4a66ea65c6c435d64
Author: Nicolas Pitre <npitre@baylibre.com>
Date:   Tue Jan 27 17:56:01 2026 -0500

    vt: save/restore unicode screen buffer for alternate screen
    
    The alternate screen support added by commit 23743ba64709 ("vt: add
    support for smput/rmput escape codes") only saves and restores the
    regular screen buffer (vc_origin), but completely ignores the corresponding
    unicode screen buffer (vc_uni_lines) creating a messed-up display.
bic_trace_step.reason: This commit adds proper saving and restoring of vc_saved_uni_lines in enter_alt_screen, leave_alt_screen, vc_deallocate, and reset_terminal, thus fixing the vulnerability described. The vulnerable construct (missing unicode buffer management) is no longer present after applying this commit.
